description: Document structure for Proposal/FORGE-{problem-slug}.md (engage-forge Step 6). Slim and decision-focused — the recommended artefact, audit findings, and critique friction points are surfaced where a user can act on them.

sections.title: Paradigms Explored
sections.description: One row per path: paradigm name, artefact type, one-sentence rationale.

sections.title: Artefacts
sections.description: One section per path. Full structured artefact + ≤200-word rationale narrative.

sections.title: Synthesis Comparison Table
sections.description: The comparison table from Step 3. Recommended path called out if one emerged.

sections.title: Heuristic Audit
sections.description: Heuristic-finding matrix from Step 4. Most-severe finding called out. Graft recommendation (or 'no graft').

sections.title: Critique
sections.description: Persona name + attributes. Exactly 3 friction points with artefact-element references and remediations.

sections.title: What Would Change This Recommendation
sections.description: 2-3 bullets naming the persona / constraint / heuristic that, if updated, would flip the recommended path.
